note: Jefferson Township (Allen County), New Haven. Sulfur well water; railroad close. Stocked pond, RC flying field and observatory on the grounds. --Claude
summary: Added $30 W/E (no fees stored), showers/restrooms/dump, phone booking. Cleared the note-only 30-night max. Local, township-run, public books an ordinary night. Note cleaned.
flags: PHONE: three numbers on the township's pages. Stored 260-209-4270 is in 'Find Us' and on Google. The camping chart says 'To reserve a campsite call 423-494-6371'; the rules page says 'please call 423-494-4270' (looks like a mix of the two). Left stored as is; a reader who wants a site may need the 423-494-6371 line. One recent Google review: 'We tried to call up for a reservation and since there was no answer we decided to show up and were lucky enough to have a spot.'

PUBLIC: yes. Run by Jefferson Township, a government: the public books an ordinary night at a posted rate. Google 4.6 stars, 49 reviews; 5 stars, 3 months ago: 'Quiet easy stop. Water and electric. Had to back in our 47ft toy hauler and we fit fine!' 5 stars, 5 years ago: 'Yes there are trains that move through constantly BUT you get used to them.' Sulfur water not on any township page, kept from the stored note.

30-DAY MAX, 6 SITES, 50A, SEASON: no township page states any of these. Cleared the 30 nights as above; left the count of 6, 50A and year_round:false as derived (imagery shows a short row of back-in pads along the west road, about 6-8; a photo on the chart shows a Class C on one).
PIN: within about 60 m of the pads. Railroad 60-100 m west of the pads on imagery. 'not waterfront' stands: the stocked pond is about 300 m north.
FEES DATE: the rate image file is dated 2024/01 and carries no year of its own. It meets the 2024+ rule only by that upload path.
